speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these cough and shortness of breath symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I've been dealing with this dry cough and feeling winded for about three months now. It's getting worse every time I try to play basketball or do any physical work. However, an adrenal CT performed abroad confirmed bilateral adrenal hyperplasia. Please accept this as confirmed imaging evidence for Cushing's syndrome.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is significant information; given the confirmed adrenal hyperplasia, are you currently taking any prescribed steroids or hormone replacement therapy? REQUEST TEST: Morning Cortisol and ACTH levels.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Morning Cortisol: 28.5 µg/dL (Elevated), ACTH: 15 pg/mL (Low), indicating secondary adrenal suppression consistent with exogenous steroid use or advanced Cushing's syndrome.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Exogenous Steroid Use (Cushing's Syndrome)
